title: Comparison transports finite etale constant models
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a finite commutative ring. Suppose an etale sheaf G of Λ-modules has an etale locally constant datum whose constant module models are finite [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values]. Then its comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] has a scheme pro-etale covering W_i → X [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] such that the inverse image on each W_i [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] is the constant sheaf of a finite Λ-module M_i [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_finite_models_of_etale_finite_values
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hG : ∃ d : LocallyConstantDatum G, ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
        Nonempty (G.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅
          (constantSheaf (X.smallEtaleTopology.over
            (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj
            ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj G)) ≅
            (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (W i))
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
